name: gnome-timezones-extension
description: Show multiple clock timezones in the panel
author: Masquerade <christian@masquerade-circus.net>

scripts.lint: gjs -c "import('./extension.js')" 2>&1 | grep -v 'imports is not defined' || true
scripts.zip: npm run compile && rm -f timezones@masquerade-circus.net.zip && zip -r timezones@masquerade-circus.net.zip extension.js timezones.js metadata.json schemas/
scripts.install:local: npm run zip && gnome-extensions install --force timezones@masquerade-circus.net.zip
